service: background-service

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: ap-south-1
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}           # deploy with --stage dev | --stage prod
  timeout: 30                          # default for HTTP endpoints
  apiGateway:
    binaryMediaTypes:                  # required so base64 xlsx bodies decode to real files
      - '*/*'
  environment:
    STAGE:                         ${sls:stage}
    VIDEO_UPLOAD_QUEUE_URL:        !Ref VideoUploadQueue
    CHAT_NOTIFICATION_QUEUE_URL:   !Ref ChatNotificationQueue
    NOTIFICATION_QUEUE_URL:        !Ref NotificationQueue
    SUPABASE_URL:                  ${ssm:/learning-app/${sls:stage}/SUPABASE_URL}
    SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:             ${ssm:/learning-app/${sls:stage}/SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}
    SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY:     ${ssm:/learning-app/${sls:stage}/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}
    BANK_ENCRYPTION_KEY:           ${ssm:/learning-app/BANK_ENCRYPTION_KEY}
    # FCM (Firebase Admin) credentials for chat push notifications.
    FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID:           ${ssm:/learning-app/FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID}
    FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL:         ${ssm:/learning-app/FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL}
    FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY:          ${ssm:/learning-app/FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY}
    # Shared secret the Supabase chat_messages webhook must present.
    CHAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET:           ${ssm:/learning-app/CHAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET}

  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - sqs:SendMessage          # ← ADDED (webhook needs to push)
            - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            - sqs:DeleteMessage
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
          Resource: !GetAtt VideoUploadQueue.Arn

        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - sqs:SendMessage          # ← ADDED
            - sqs:ReceiveMessage
            - sqs:DeleteMessage
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
          Resource: !GetAtt ChatNotificationQueue.Arn

        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - sqs:SendMessage          # streak cron pushes jobs
            - sqs:ReceiveMessage       # notification worker consumes
            - sqs:DeleteMessage
            - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
          Resource: !GetAtt NotificationQueue.Arn

plugins:
  - serverless-offline

custom:
  serverless-offline:
    httpPort: 3000
    lambdaPort: 3003

resources:
  Resources:

    # ── Dead Letter Queues ──────────────────────────────────────
    VideoUploadDLQ:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: video-upload-dlq-${sls:stage}
        MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600    # 14 days

    ChatNotificationDLQ:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: chat-notification-dlq-${sls:stage}
        MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600    # 14 days

    NotificationDLQ:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: notification-dlq-${sls:stage}
        MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600    # 14 days

    # ── Main Queues ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    VideoUploadQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: video-upload-queue-${sls:stage}
        VisibilityTimeout: 300
        RedrivePolicy:
          deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt VideoUploadDLQ.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: 3             # retry 3 times then → DLQ

    ChatNotificationQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: chat-notification-queue-${sls:stage}
        VisibilityTimeout: 300
        RedrivePolicy:
          deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt ChatNotificationDLQ.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: 3

    # Shared queue for ALL push scenarios (streak reward/broken, …). Producers
    # enqueue { type, user_id, data }; notificationWorker switches on `type`.
    NotificationQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: notification-queue-${sls:stage}
        VisibilityTimeout: 300
        RedrivePolicy:
          deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt NotificationDLQ.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: 3

functions:

  # ── HTTP Endpoints ──────────────────────────────────────────

  saveBankDetails:
    handler: src/functions/bank/saveBankDetails.handler
    events:
      - http:
          path:   faculty/bank/details
          method: post
          cors:   true

  getBankDetails:
    handler: src/functions/bank/getBankDetails.handler
    events:
      - http:
          path:   faculty/bank/details
          method: get
          cors:   true

  exportCourseEnrollments:
    handler: src/functions/csvExpoter/admin/enrollmentExport.handler
    events:
      - http:
          path:   admin/courses/{courseId}/enrollments/export
          method: get
          cors:   true

  exportCourseEnrollmentsFaculty:
    handler: src/functions/csvExpoter/faculty/enrollmentExport.handler
    events:
      - http:
          path:   faculty/courses/{courseId}/enrollments/export
          method: get
          cors:   true

  # ── Webhooks ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  tpstreamsWebhook:
    handler: src/functions/webhooks/tpstreamsWebhook.handler
    timeout: 10                          # short — just pushes to SQS
    events:
      - http:
          path: /webhooks/tpstreams
          method: post

  # Supabase database webhook: fires on every chat_messages INSERT and enqueues
  # a chat push job. Authenticated via the x-webhook-secret header.
  chatMessageWebhook:
    handler: src/functions/webhooks/chatMessageWebhook.handler
    timeout: 10                          # short — just pushes to SQS
    events:
      - http:
          path: /webhooks/chat-message
          method: post

  # ── SQS Background Jobs ─────────────────────────────────────

  processVideoUpload:
    handler: src/functions/video/processVideoUpload.handler
    timeout: 300                         # long — does heavy DB work
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: !GetAtt VideoUploadQueue.Arn
          batchSize: 1
          functionResponseType: ReportBatchItemFailures

  chatNotificationWorker:
    handler: src/functions/chat/chat.notification.handler
    timeout: 60                          # medium — notification work
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: !GetAtt ChatNotificationQueue.Arn
          batchSize: 1
          functionResponseType: ReportBatchItemFailures   # ← ADDED

  # Shared push worker — drains NotificationQueue and fans each job out to FCM
  # + an in-app notifications row, based on the job's `type`.
  notificationWorker:
    handler: src/functions/notification/notificationWorker.handler
    timeout: 60
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn: !GetAtt NotificationQueue.Arn
          batchSize: 1
          functionResponseType: ReportBatchItemFailures

  # ── Scheduled Jobs ──────────────────────────────────────────

  # Cron A — daily student-streak settlement. Runs at DAY-END (00:00 IST /
  # 18:30 UTC) for the day that just ended: updates streak_days, awards coins on
  # the goal, resets broken streaks, and STAGES reward/broken pushes into
  # scheduled_notifications (scheduled_for = the coming 08:00 IST). No push yet.
  studentStreakCron:
    handler: src/functions/streak/updateStreaks.handler
    timeout: 300
    events:
      - schedule:
          rate: cron(30 18 * * ? *)      # 18:30 UTC = 00:00 IST (day end)
          enabled: true

  # Cron B — notification dispatch. Runs 08:00 IST (02:30 UTC): drains every
  # due scheduled_notifications row onto NotificationQueue → notificationWorker
  # → FCM. This is the "scheduled delivery" step for jobs staged at midnight.
  notificationDispatchCron:
    handler: src/functions/notification/notificationDispatch.handler
    timeout: 300
    events:
      - schedule:
          rate: cron(30 2 * * ? *)       # 02:30 UTC = 08:00 IST daily
          enabled: true
